newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 4.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abidjan: symbol of Africa on the move - a reproduction of a report on Ivory Coast's commercial capital by Paris-based magazine Jeune Afrique.
- President Henri Konan Bedie to attend Franco-African starting in Burkina Faso today
- About 3,000 jobs projected at Borotou-Koro sugar plantation in western Ivory Coast, minister says.
- Mine Or SA buys 11 percent of shares in state-owned Ity Goldmine at total cost of 3.2 billion CFA francs, Mine Or president Andre Papon says.
- High School teachers start protest action today in northern town of Khorogo over pay and conditions.
- Succession of U.N. Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali - Ivorian Foreign Minister Essy Amara is a candidate.
